title: Apartment hunt notes — comparing places, corrections collapsed
raw: okay so apartment notes from today so the first place on clinton street was two bedrooms at twenty eight hundred a month no wait twenty eight fifty and it was on the third floor and the kitchen was actually renovated which was nice but there's no dishwasher and the bedroom windows face the air shaft so basically no light and the landlord seemed a little sketchy honestly and the second place on bedford avenue was one bedroom at twenty two hundred and it had a private outdoor space like a little backyard thing and it was way brighter but it's on the ground floor which i'm a little nervous about for safety reasons and the third one on graham avenue was also two bedrooms at three thousand no two thousand nine hundred and it was huge like fifteen hundred square feet maybe and newly renovated throughout but it's on the fourth floor and there's no elevator and i have a lot of stuff so that's a real concern and my ranking right now is bedford first then graham then clinton and i want to go back to bedford this weekend to see it again at a different time of day
reference: Apartment notes from today. The first place on Clinton Street is two bedrooms at $2,850/month, third floor. The kitchen is renovated, but no dishwasher, bedroom windows face the air shaft so basically no light, and the landlord seemed a little sketchy. The second place on Bedford Avenue is one bedroom at $2,200, ground floor. It has a private backyard, way brighter, but the ground floor makes me nervous from a safety standpoint. The third place on Graham Avenue is two bedrooms at $2,900, about 1,500 square feet, newly renovated, but it's on the fourth floor with no elevator and I have a lot of stuff. My ranking is Bedford first, then Graham, then Clinton. Want to go back to Bedford this weekend at a different time of day.
